title: sideritis × paui subsp. tomas-barberanii
intro: Sideritis × paui subsp. tomas-barberanii, commonly known as Tomás Barberá's Sideritis, is a plant species within the genus Sideritis and the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in the Mediterranean region for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Tomás Barberá's Sideritis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, particularly borneol, camphor, and limonene. These bioactive compounds have been shown to exhibit various pharmacological activities, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
